coder_notes: Dendritic cell vaccine is an excluded intervention type; no candidate. The Td booster is not a cancer vaccine and its purpose is not stated; coded supportive (non-candidate) as the nearest fit. GM-CSF is registered only inside the vaccine intervention name. Temozolomide is background (patients must already be on adjuvant TMZ), not a registered intervention but received by every patient. The pp65 (CMV antigen) is not a tumour molecular biomarker.
